description: Wind and solar capacity factor profiles (p_max_pu) at each generator's location from Renewables Vision, Convexity's own weather service (ERA5, 1940 to last year): to fill a model's profiles, or for weather sensitivities. One year goes in scenario ("base" for the model itself, else made if new); several years make an ensemble, one scenario per year named "<ensemble>/<year>". preview: compare years' average capacity factors without changing anything, e.g. to find the stillest year; for "how sensitive is it to the weather", preview, then offer an ensemble. Defaults to every wind and solar generator.

preview.description: Only report each year’s average capacity factors.

scenario.description: One year: the scenario to write into, by name or id, made if new; "base" only when the user asked to change the model itself.

tech.description: Which generators, by carrier. Default both.

name: fill_weather
